mapper.sql: select id, conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, extra_json, status, check_status, trace_id, client_message_id, request_hash, create_time, date_format(coalesce(visible_at, create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') as visible_order_at from im_message
mapper.insert: insert into im_message (conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, extra_json, status, check_status, trace_id, client_message_id, request_hash, create_time, visible_at) values (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{extraJson}, #{status}, #{checkStatus}, #{traceId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{requestHash}, now(6), case when #{msgType} = 2 and (#{checkStatus} is null or #{checkStatus} != 1) then null else now(6) end)
mapper.select: where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and sender_id = #{senderId} and client_message_id = #{clientMessageId}
where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.sql: status != 2 and (msg_type != 2 or check_status = 1 or sender_id = #{viewerMemberId})
mapper.select: where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and order by coalesce(visible_at, create_time) desc, id desc limit 1 lock in share mode

mapper.sql: select coalesce(visible_at, create_time) from im_message where id = #{afterId} and conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.update: update im_message set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update im_message set status = #{toStatus} where id = #{id} and status = #{fromStatus}

update im_message msg left join im_conversation c on c.id = msg.conversation_id and c.status = 0 left join im_conversation_member recipient on recipient.conversation_id = c.id and recipient.member_id != msg.sender_id and (c.type != 4 or recipient.deleted = 0) set msg.check_status = 21 , msg.status = 2 , msg.visible_at = now(6), recipient.unread_count = recipient.unread_count + 1, recipient.deleted = 0 where msg.id = #{id} and msg.trace_id = #{traceId} and msg.check_status = 0
